description:
Job Description: 
 
 Must have Experience with REST and JSON payloads. 
 Must have Experience with Queues - RabbitMQ or similar. 
 Must have Experience in integrating with enterprise applications like CRM applications, Point of Sale and eCommerce integration using enterprise integration tools like Mulesoft, TIBCO, Message Broker/ DataPower the like. 
 Hands-on experience in JAVA/J2EE 
 Must have Experience working hands-on in APIs and Integration using Mulesoft (or similar middleware software) and Java/Spring integration for 5 years in large scale Enterprise 
 Must have Experience in Enterprise API specification and development. 
 Exposure to cloud environments such as AWS. 
 Knowledge of deployment and testing automation used for continuous delivery using Maven and Jenkins 
 Experience with requirements, task, and change management systems 
 

 Primary Skills: 
 REST and JSON, Queues – RabbitMQ, CRM applications, Mulesoft/TIBCO/Message Broker/ DataPower, JAVA/J2EE, Cloud, continuous delivery using Maven and Jenkins 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
